- [Architecture](architecture.md) — ownership, service boundaries, and durable state.

- [Blocking contract conflicts](blocking-contract-conflicts.md) — prerequisite readiness gap in the frozen Planner flow.
- [Frozen V2 contract](../contracts/practice-runtime-v2.md) — authoritative HTTP, identity, lifecycle, and provider contracts.
- [Student execution projection V1](../contracts/student-execution-projection-v1.md) — additive bounded read facts for Student's authoritative NextActionResolver.

The frozen contract SHA-256 is `6a2b537ba1f6d0a1272898678245723b37eed83185b17b7de4f3ff02e8ae5958`; `.ai/scripts/check-agent-policy.sh` verifies it. The contract file is the source of truth for exact payloads and state transitions.
